title: Pakistani gunsmith who hammers out AKs from aircraft scrap on a granite rock

tellings.quote: there's a guy that lives just cross the border in Pakistan lives in a mud hut

plain: Just across the Afghan border in Pakistan, a man living in a mud hut makes working AK assault rifles by hammering scrap metal from aircraft on a granite rock. Joe McMoneagle, a former Army remote viewer, someone trained to describe distant places by mind alone, tells the story as something he was told. He uses it to show how much skill can exist far from modern factories.
